title: Ontology of Continua Core v1.4
description:
Ontology of Continua Core v1.4 is the current public release pointer for the bounded external-review scientific release of the OC core model. It provides typed foundations, proof and evidence registers, Lean and finite-model evidence, target-blind replay QA summaries, reproducibility material, and adversarial-review artifacts.

The release promotes only model-core claims supported by the included evidence. Broader full-science completion and unbounded cross-science comparison obligations remain outside this release surface.

Attribution

Author: Alexander Yashin, Independent Researcher, ORCID 0009-0008-6166-0914. Logion and ESTRA are preparation, checking, packaging, audit, and methodology instruments; neither is a creator, co-author, or author affiliation.

Recommended reading order

  1. Release Guide - 00_OC_CORE_1_3_3_RELEASE_GUIDE_EN.pdf
  2. Master Monograph - OC_CORE_1_3_3_MASTER_MONOGRAPH_EN.pdf
  3. Journal Core - OC_CORE_1_3_3_JOURNAL_CORE_EN.pdf
  4. Methods and Reproducibility Companion - OC_CORE_1_3_3_METHODS_AND_REPRODUCIBILITY_COMPANION_EN.pdf
  5. Reviewer Attack and Response Map - OC_CORE_1_3_3_REVIEWER_ATTACK_AND_RESPONSE_MAP_EN.pdf
  6. Public reproducibility package - oc_core_1_3_3_public_release.zip

Release contents

  • Five substantive English PDF documents: release guide, master monograph, journal core article, methods companion, and reviewer response map.
  • One public reproducibility package with proof, validation, review, metadata, checksums, and journal owner-review materials.
  • Checksums are provided in checksums.txt.

Governance boundary

This metadata is prepared for owner review and archival packaging. Journal submission, email campaigns, Software Heritage deposit, DOI minting, and public promotion actions require separate owner approval.
